text:
Alex K: FYI — Sentinel Corp preflight tomorrow 09:00 PST. I'm handing off primary oncall for the window. Short checklist below. Please RSVP if you're swapping. /cc @Maya S

- customer: sentinel-corp (VIP)
- scope: config rollout + synthetic load up to 150rps for 45m starting 09:15
- expected SLOs: p95 latency < 300ms, error rate < 0.5%
- known risk: model fallback may trigger for very long prompts; KV cache warmup required
- runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sentinel-preflight
- escalation: Oliver T -> Sarah P -> Eng Leads

Devon R: I'll be on standby 08:45-10:30, can cover tail-end if needed.

Maya S: I can take primary from 08:50-10:20. Confirming I'm good to accept handoff.

Alex K: Cool — Maya, steps I did:
1) pre-warmed 6 dedicated slots on vk-gpu-us-west2
2) pinned model gptx-1.3q on the staging cluster
3) preloaded prompt cache for sentinel prompt set (cache keys: sent-pref-*)
Logs check:
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=serving | grep ready
serving-aaa 1/1 Running
serving-bbb 1/1 Running
```
Routing override to force dedicated:
```
redwood route set --customer sentinel-corp --mode dedicated --weight 100
```

Oliver T: Quick Q — what's the burst budget? need to set autoscale policy so we don't hit infra limits. :eyes:

Alex K: Burst configured to 200RPS per pod, but autoscaler maxPods=20. I left a note in the console config: /configs/sentinel-autoscale

Sarah P: Reminder: if fallback to hosted occurs, alerting will fire to #incidents and oncall will be paged. Make sure the fwd rule to PagerDuty is enabled in the runbook.

Devon R: Any specific test prompts to run? I'll prepare a small set.

Alex K: Use testset: sent-preflight-2026-03 (S3). Short examples: "Generate account summary for org X with 10k tokens", "rerank top 20". Long prompt triggers are the risk.

Maya S: I'll update the runbook with the swap note and contact: eng-sentry-phone +1-555-0112. Also adding a short checklist to the top of the runbook. :white_check_mark:

Oncall Bot: Rotation update recorded: primary=Maya S start=1839876600 end=1839878400

Alex K: Thanks — will DM Sentinel support on their Slack channel at 08:55 to coordinate ramp.

Maya S: Acknowledged. I'll take screenshots of the initial 5 minutes and post in this thread.

Devon R: ping me 09:10 if you need help ramping load.

Alex K: Closing handoff — leaving console links and snippets above. Good luck :rocket:
